title: "Cluster Analysis - Loyalty Program"
output: pdf_document
date: "2026-04-14"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(cluster)
```


```{r}
customers <- read_excel("Loyalty Program Data.xlsx", sheet = "customers")
purchase_records <- read_excel("Loyalty Program Data.xlsx", sheet = "purchase records")
redeem_records <- read_excel("Loyalty Program Data.xlsx", sheet = "redeem records")
```

```{r}
purchase_records$SalesDate <- as.POSIXct(purchase_records$SalesDate, format = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M")
redeem_records$RedeemDate <- as.POSIXct(redeem_records$RedeemDate, format = "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M")
```

```{r}
customer_summary <- purchase_records %>%
  group_by(MemberID) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Purchases = n(),
    Total_Spent = sum(SalesAmt, na.rm = TRUE),
    Unique_Merchants = n_distinct(SalesFirm),
    First_Purchase = min(SalesDate),
    Last_Purchase = max(SalesDate),
    Days_Active = as.numeric(difftime(Last_Purchase, First_Purchase, units = "days")),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

customer_redemption <- redeem_records %>%
  group_by(MemberID) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Redemptions = n(),
    Total_Points_Redeemed = sum(RedeemPoint, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

customer_full <- customers %>%
  left_join(customer_summary, by = "MemberID") %>%
  left_join(customer_redemption, by = "MemberID") %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Purchases = coalesce(Total_Purchases, 0),
    Total_Spent = coalesce(Total_Spent, 0),
    Unique_Merchants = coalesce(Unique_Merchants, 0),
    Days_Active = coalesce(Days_Active, 0),
    Total_Redemptions = coalesce(Total_Redemptions, 0),
    Total_Points_Redeemed = coalesce(Total_Points_Redeemed, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
merchant_spend <- purchase_records %>%
  group_by(MemberID, SalesFirm) %>%
  summarise(
    Spend = sum(SalesAmt, na.rm = TRUE),
    Purchases = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = SalesFirm,
    values_from = c(Spend, Purchases),
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

```{r}
cluster_data <- customer_full %>%
  select(
    MemberID,
    Total_Purchases,
    Total_Spent,
    Unique_Merchants,
    Days_Active,
    Total_Redemptions,
    Total_Points_Redeemed
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Avg_Transaction = ifelse(Total_Purchases > 0, Total_Spent / Total_Purchases, 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(merchant_spend, by = "MemberID") %>%
  mutate(
    Spend_FastFood = coalesce(Spend_FastFood, 0),
    Spend_Grocery = coalesce(Spend_Grocery, 0),
    Spend_Petrol = coalesce(Spend_Petrol, 0),
    Purchases_FastFood = coalesce(Purchases_FastFood, 0),
    Purchases_Grocery = coalesce(Purchases_Grocery, 0),
    Purchases_Petrol = coalesce(Purchases_Petrol, 0)
  )

cluster_data[is.na(cluster_data)] <- 0
```

```{r}
cluster_features <- cluster_data %>%
  select(-MemberID) %>%
  mutate(across(-Unique_Merchants, log1p))

cluster_scaled <- scale(cluster_features)
```

```{r}
wss <- numeric(10)

for (k in 1:10) {
  set.seed(123)
  wss[k] <- kmeans(cluster_scaled, centers = k, nstart = 25)$tot.withinss
}

plot(
  1:10, wss,
  type = "b", pch = 19,
  xlab = "Number of Clusters (k)",
  ylab = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares",
  main = "Elbow Method for Choosing k"
)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
k3 <- kmeans(cluster_scaled, centers = 3, nstart = 25)

cluster_assignments <- cluster_data %>%
  select(MemberID) %>%
  mutate(Cluster = as.factor(k3$cluster))
```

```{r}
customer_clusters <- customer_full %>%
  left_join(cluster_assignments, by = "MemberID") %>%
  left_join(
    cluster_data %>%
      select(
        MemberID,
        Spend_FastFood,
        Spend_Grocery,
        Spend_Petrol,
        Purchases_FastFood,
        Purchases_Grocery,
        Purchases_Petrol
      ),
    by = "MemberID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Churned = ifelse(Active2018 == "Y" & Active2019 == "N", 1, 0),
    Age = 2019 - BirthYear
  )
```

```{r}
cluster_profile <- customer_clusters %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    Customers = n(),
    Avg_Total_Spent = mean(Total_Spent, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Purchases = mean(Total_Purchases, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Unique_Merchants = mean(Unique_Merchants, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Days_Active = mean(Days_Active, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Redemptions = mean(Total_Redemptions, na.rm = TRUE),
    Churn_Rate = mean(Churned, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Sat_Program = mean(Sat_Program, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_NPS = mean(NetPromoter, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Age = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
cluster_profile_table <- cluster_profile %>%
  mutate(
    Segment = case_when(
      Cluster == "1" ~ "Low-Engagement At-Risk",
      Cluster == "2" ~ "Moderate-Value Single-Merchant",
      Cluster == "3" ~ "High-Value Multi-Merchant Loyal",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cluster)
    ),
    Avg_Total_Spent = round(Avg_Total_Spent, 2),
    Avg_Purchases = round(Avg_Purchases, 2),
    Avg_Unique_Merchants = round(Avg_Unique_Merchants, 2),
    Avg_Days_Active = round(Avg_Days_Active, 2),
    Avg_Redemptions = round(Avg_Redemptions, 2),
    Churn_Rate = paste0(round(Churn_Rate * 100, 1), "%"),
    Avg_Sat_Program = round(Avg_Sat_Program, 2),
    Avg_NPS = round(Avg_NPS, 2),
    Avg_Age = round(Avg_Age, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Cluster,
    Segment,
    Customers,
    Avg_Total_Spent,
    Avg_Purchases,
    Avg_Unique_Merchants,
    Avg_Days_Active,
    Avg_Redemptions,
    Churn_Rate,
    Avg_Sat_Program,
    Avg_NPS,
    Avg_Age
  )

kable(cluster_profile_table, caption = "Cluster Profile Summary")
```

```{r}
churn_summary <- customer_clusters %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    Customers = n(),
    Churned_Customers = sum(Churned, na.rm = TRUE),
    Churn_Rate = mean(Churned, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Segment = case_when(
      Cluster == "1" ~ "Low-Engagement At-Risk",
      Cluster == "2" ~ "Moderate-Value Single-Merchant",
      Cluster == "3" ~ "High-Value Multi-Merchant Loyal",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cluster)
    ),
    Churn_Rate = paste0(round(Churn_Rate * 100, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  select(
    Cluster,
    Segment,
    Customers,
    Churned_Customers,
    Churn_Rate
  )

kable(churn_summary, caption = "Churn Summary by Cluster")
```

```{r}
merchant_usage_summary <- customer_clusters %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Unique_Merchants = mean(Unique_Merchants, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_FastFood_Spend = mean(Spend_FastFood, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Grocery_Spend = mean(Spend_Grocery, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Petrol_Spend = mean(Spend_Petrol, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_FastFood_Purchases = mean(Purchases_FastFood, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Grocery_Purchases = mean(Purchases_Grocery, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Petrol_Purchases = mean(Purchases_Petrol, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Segment = case_when(
      Cluster == "1" ~ "Low-Engagement At-Risk",
      Cluster == "2" ~ "Moderate-Value Single-Merchant",
      Cluster == "3" ~ "High-Value Multi-Merchant Loyal",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cluster)
    ),
    Avg_Unique_Merchants = round(Avg_Unique_Merchants, 2),
    Avg_FastFood_Spend = round(Avg_FastFood_Spend, 2),
    Avg_Grocery_Spend = round(Avg_Grocery_Spend, 2),
    Avg_Petrol_Spend = round(Avg_Petrol_Spend, 2),
    Avg_FastFood_Purchases = round(Avg_FastFood_Purchases, 2),
    Avg_Grocery_Purchases = round(Avg_Grocery_Purchases, 2),
    Avg_Petrol_Purchases = round(Avg_Petrol_Purchases, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Cluster,
    Segment,
    Avg_Unique_Merchants,
    Avg_FastFood_Spend,
    Avg_Grocery_Spend,
    Avg_Petrol_Spend,
    Avg_FastFood_Purchases,
    Avg_Grocery_Purchases,
    Avg_Petrol_Purchases
  )

kable(merchant_usage_summary, caption = "Merchant Usage by Cluster")
```

```{r}
ggplot(cluster_profile, aes(x = Cluster, y = Avg_Total_Spent)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Spend by Cluster",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Average Total Spend"
  )
ggplot(cluster_profile, aes(x = Cluster, y = Customers)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Customers by Cluster",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Number of Customers"
  )
ggplot(cluster_profile, aes(x = Cluster, y = Churn_Rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Churn Rate by Cluster",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Churn Rate"
  )
```
